notes.content: Important Information about the Music major Core CourSES

MUS 130 - Piano III: Based on placement evaluation, with advisor's consent, pianists may substitute a voice or instrument class. MUS 106 & MUS 107 Ensembles: four semesters required. See separate list of specific ensemble requirements for each instrument, available from the Music Department (707) 826-3531 or https://music.humboldt.edu

notes.content: Important Information about the Music Studies Concentration: five semesters of MUS 220 - 237 Intermediate Studio Instrument or Voice Instructions required for minimum of 5 units total in group or individual applied instruction. MUS 108K and MUS 109K may not be used to fulfill this requirement.
